subject: Partner marketplace credits for Accelerator cohort — approval & next steps
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@dataedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@amazon.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@accellabs.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Partner credits for our accelerator cohort (ask)

Hi Marissa / Rafael —

Thanks again for the call earlier. DataEdge is launching a new 8-week AI accelerator for 12 enterprise teams in March. As discussed, we want to offer each cohort customer an on-ramp: $2k in marketplace credits plus 90-day trial extensions that apply to Redwood usage billed via the AWS Marketplace.

Ask: can Redwood accept partner-sourced AWS Marketplace promotional credits and apply them directly to a customer’s subscription? If yes, can you confirm how credits surface on your billing, and any limits we should be aware of (expiration, stacking with Redwood trial credits)?

We’re happy to put these on a DocuSign addendum (attached sample) and share a draft promotion landing page for legal. We can cover AWS marketplace transaction fees.

Thanks —
Priya
VP Partnerships, DataEdge
attachments: accelerator_promo_terms.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@dataedge.com>, Daniel Kim <dan.kim@amazon.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@accellabs.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2026-02-06 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credits for our accelerator cohort (ask)

Priya —

Really excited about this accelerator — congrats on the lineup. Short answers below and looping in Rafael (revenue ops) and Sean (legal interface for partner credits).

- Yes, we can accept partner-provided promo credits from AWS Marketplace but there are two paths: (1) credits applied via a marketplace promotion code tied to the customer’s marketplace subscription, or (2) a partner-funded invoice credit we apply on our side after verifying settlement.
- Marketplace promo codes are preferable for speed; Redwood will consume the credit against the customer’s Marketplace-billed usage first, then fall back to their payment method. Credits must be provisioned at least 7 days before the start of billing to show on month-end statements.
- Limits: promo codes can be scoped per account and expire; stacking with Redwood trial credits is allowed but we’ll reflect that as two line items on the invoice.

Next steps I propose:
1) Daniel — can AWS Marketplace create a promo code for the DataEdge cohort scope (12 accounts, $2k each)?
2) Priya/Alex — send the final participant list and the landing page.
3) Rafael / Sean — internal approval on ledger flow and whether we need a quick addendum (DocuSign link below).

Attaching the sample promo terms we discussed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@dataedge.com>
Date: Wed, 2026-02-07 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credits for our accelerator cohort (ask)

Marissa / Priya —

We can create a marketplace promotion code that issues $24k total across the 12 accounts ($2k each). Two operational notes:

1) Promotion codes must be scoped to specific AWS Account IDs or consolidated via the reseller relationship. If DataEdge will onboard customers under their partner umbrella, provide the consolidated IDs; otherwise provide the list of 12 AWS account IDs.

2) Expiration: we’ll set a 120-day expiration by default; we can shorten if needed.

I’ll generate a promo code and share the redemption sheet once you confirm the account IDs. Expect a marketplace reference number and initial statement within 48–72 hours.

—Daniel
AWS Marketplace, Partner Programs

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2026-02-10 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Partner credits for our accelerator cohort (internal: finance/ops check)

Marissa / Sean —

Forwarding the thread. Quick ops notes from my side:
- We need to record a contra-revenue line in our billing system when credits are applied via AWS Marketplace. Accounting prefers a monthly amortization entry for any credits > $10k total per promotion. For $24k this qualifies.
- Please confirm whether we should route the promo to the customer invoice (visible as Marketplace credit) or apply an internal credit memo after settlement. The customer experience is cleaner if the credit appears on the invoice line item from Marketplace.

Also attaching a proposed short addendum (DocuSign) to capture partner-funded credits and acceptance of Redwood’s trial-extension policy. Rafael attached: marketplace_credit_statement.xlsx

Can you both confirm by EOD that we’re OK to proceed? If Sean flags contractual language, I can hold the promo until DocuSign is signed.

Thanks —
Rafael
Director, Revenue Operations
attachments: marketplace_credit_statement.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya@dataedge.com>, Daniel Kim <dan.kim@amazon.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@accellabs.com>
Date: Wed, 2026-02-11 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner credits for our accelerator cohort (ask)

All —

Thanks for the clear notes. Legal reviewed the addendum; two very small edits made (liability cap language and explicit expiration/void conditions for unused credits). I’ve uploaded the redlines to DocuSign and created an execution envelope for Priya and Marissa. Link below.

Operational decision: allow marketplace promo code redemption so the credit is visible on the customer invoice (preferred customer UX). Rafael — accounting will amortize per your suggestion.

Priya — once you confirm the 12 AWS Account IDs and sign the addendum, Daniel can issue the promo code and we’ll route the credits. Alex — please coordinate with your landing page to include the promo code redemption steps.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/accelerator-addendum/RWI-2026-0321
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

If there are no further comments I’ll finalize the envelope.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
